slides.name: Born in Roma Intense
slides.copy: Soft lavender pulled into deep vanilla and smoke. This is the coat you never want to take off.

slides.name: Oajan
slides.copy: Liquid honey poured over warm spice. It lingers like an open fire in an empty room.

slides.name: Jubilation XXV Man
slides.copy: Frankincense and dark fruit over ancient woods. The kind of complexity that takes years to fully understand.

slides.name: Baraonda
slides.copy: Wine and whiskey distilled into skin. Bold, addictive, and entirely unforgettable.

slides.name: 03 Lonestar Memories
slides.copy: Old leather and smoke beneath a pale winter sky. You've never smelled anything quite like this.

carousels.title: 5 Fragrances That Smell Like a Different Life

slides.name: Coco Mademoiselle
slides.copy: Crisp citrus that melts into rose, then settles into something earthy and entirely your own. The standard for a reason.

slides.name: By the Fireplace
slides.copy: Chestnuts, smoke, and warm vanilla — the exact feeling of coming in from the cold. Wears like a memory.

slides.name: Ivory Route
slides.copy: Warm spice over smooth sandalwood, trail-blazing and unhurried. Wear this and you've already left.

slides.name: Narcotic Venus
slides.copy: White flowers turned intoxicating — tuberose so dense it stops the room. A short sentence can't hold it.

slides.name: Russian Musk
slides.copy: Forest floor, old oud, and cool musk that drifts like smoke through pines. Nothing prepares you for it.

carousels.title: 5 Fragrances People Look Up After Smelling You

slides.name: Black Opium
slides.copy: Coffee and dark florals with a vanilla trail that lingers for hours. Everyone will notice before they ask.

slides.name: Intoxicated
slides.copy: Turkish coffee, cardamom, and thick caramel — gourmand without being sweet. Rich in a way that makes people turn around.

slides.name: Roses Vanille
slides.copy: One rose, stretched over pure vanilla and cedar. Simple enough to remember, complex enough to ask about.

slides.name: Blamage
slides.copy: You'll struggle to explain it — earthy, intimate, raw. That's exactly why they'll ask.

slides.name: Une Rose Chyprée
slides.copy: A true old-school chypre rose — earthy, warm, and completely out of time. The kind of fragrance that starts conversations.
